**Yes.** Hansen detected 1.8 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2019, about 0.05% of the property. The event meets the tool’s corroboration rule, although the JRC mapped the entire event area as forest in 2020.

The 2021 MGAP map classifies the event area as planted pine forest, not native forest. Hansen also detected 3.1 hectares of loss in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares; these were not counted as an event under the tool’s minimum-area rule.
